issues.description: Scenarios placed in the shared '## Scenarios' section by export --new are outside the requirement unit (requirement_spans stops at '##'). A later export of an edited requirement replaces the OpenSpec block without them, silently deleting scenarios.
issues.recommendation: Include Covers-linked scenarios in unit/hash/export rendering; add regression --new -> edit requirement -> export keeping scenarios.

issues.description: Link check runs only for a complete triple. An existing topic missing requirements.md or tasks.md makes read_prior_triple() return None and import takes the fresh path (lines 188-199), overwriting authored files or relinking without conflict (REQ-035).
issues.recommendation: Check topic existence and openspec_source independently of triple completeness; reject an incomplete existing topic with no writes.

issues.description: Batch sync is all-or-nothing only in planning. apply_merge writes topics sequentially; a writer/path-guard failure in topic 2 leaves topic 1 modified (REQ-036).
issues.recommendation: Validate all destinations before writing; apply transactionally or with journal/rollback.

issues.description: No snapshot re-check between reading/planning the bank triple and write_topic; a concurrent bank edit is overwritten by the planned stale version.
issues.recommendation: Re-verify triple and sidecar per topic immediately before apply, under a lock.

issues.description: CAS still has a TOCTOU window: unconditional writes follow _assert_unchanged (250-252); rebaseline checks the bank at 276 then writes sidecar and stale requirements.md at 289.
issues.recommendation: Combine validation and publication in a locked transaction; check drift at each replace; recover from partial apply.

issues.description: export --new reads the bank once and, after create/resume of the change, rewrites tasks.md and requirements.md (222-228) without re-checking; a concurrent bank edit is lost.
issues.recommendation: Re-compare bank snapshot before linking; guard the three bank writes in one transaction.

issues.description: A task unit added on both sides with the same text but different checkbox states has no baseline and is not UNKNOWN; sync reports no conflict and records divergent states as baseline.
issues.recommendation: With no checkbox baseline and differing values, require conflict/--take as for UNKNOWN.

issues.description: No-clobber race between exists() and os.rename(): POSIX rename can replace a concurrently created empty destination directory.
issues.recommendation: Reserve the destination exclusively or use NOREPLACE-style atomic publication.

note: first run at high timed out at 900s (empty); retry at medium succeeded. 'medium' severity used as requested by caller; parsers limited to blocker|major|minor|info should treat it as minor.
